meta.title: Piroliswiss · Hardwood charcoal from recovered forest residue
meta.description: Producer and exporter of hardwood lump charcoal, pyroligneous acid and charcoal briquettes, made in metal retorts from licensed forest residue. Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia.

hero.alt: Freshly discharged hardwood charcoal piled at the Piroliswiss production site under open sky
hero.title: Hardwood charcoal from recovered forest residue.
hero.sub: Curupaú and Quebracho Colorado hardwoods from licensed land-use change, carbonised in industrial metal retorts for steelworks, agriculture and premium BBQ.

problems.label: The problems
problems.title: Good hardwood is burned in the field while industry and farms pay more for less.

items.alt: Forest residue burning in the field
items.title: Forest residue is wasted
items.text: Millions of tonnes of forest residue are burned, abandoned or underused, causing pollution and economic loss.

items.alt: Steel plant with raw material yard
items.title: Industrial charcoal is scarce
items.text: In Brazil, growing demand from pulp companies has created a shortage of industrial charcoal for steelworks.

items.alt: Tractor working on farmland in Santa Cruz
items.title: Farm inputs cost too much
items.text: High fertiliser and agrochemical prices cut farm margins and raise the need for local, sustainable alternatives.

solutions.title: Turn forest residue into industrial products
solutions.text: Controlled pyrolysis converts forest residue into high-value industrial products.

solutions.title: Constant industrial supply
solutions.text: Steady, scalable charcoal production for steelworks, especially in Brazil and Asia.

solutions.title: Natural agricultural inputs
solutions.text: A biomass-derived bio-input that reduces dependence on agrochemicals and supports more sustainable farming.

products.label: Products
products.title: One process, three products.
products.lede: Charcoal is the core. The liquid and the fines that other kilns lose become two more product lines.

items.alt: Piece of dense hardwood charcoal held in hand, showing a glassy fracture
items.title: Premium lump charcoal
items.desc: Our main product is a high-quality charcoal made from selected hardwoods such as Curupaú and Quebracho Colorado, known for their high density, strength and excellent energy yield.
features: Suitable for industrial and export markets

spec.v: Bulk · 400 kg big-bag · 5, 10 and 30 kg bags

items.alt: Metal retort with condenser column where pyroligneous acid is recovered
items.title: Pyroligneous acid
items.desc: Pyroligneous acid, also known as wood vinegar, is a liquid by-product obtained during the pyrolysis of biomass. Recovering it lets us use the entire production process, producing an input with agricultural, forestry and industrial applications and adding value to the operation.
features: Can be used as an agricultural biostimulant
Acts as a natural insect repellent
Can support the control of soil fungi and diseases
Applied diluted with water, liquid compost, biofertilisers or organic preparations
Helps reduce dependence on synthetic chemicals
items.app: Crop protection, natural pest control and fewer chemical inputs.

spec.v: Filtered, settled and free of suspended solids

items.alt: Charcoal burning evenly on a test grate
items.title: Eco charcoal briquettes
items.desc: Made from compacted charcoal fines, briquettes turn a residue of our production process into a higher-value commercial product.
items.app: High-performance fuel for grills, gastronomy and gourmet export.

process.label: Process
process.title: Carbonisation is a temperature curve. We run it inside steel.
process.lede: A retort heats wood without air. Each stage happens at its own temperature, and each one is measured inside the kiln with four probes connected to Piroliswiss Control.

ui.aria: Retort in the {phase} phase; probes at {t} °C

phases.name: Drying
phases.text: The wood loses its moisture. Water vapour leaves through the chimney before decomposition begins.

phases.name: Torrefaction
phases.text: Hemicellulose breaks down and the wood darkens. The first vapours condense as pyroligneous acid.

phases.name: Carbonisation
phases.text: Cellulose and lignin break down. Gas that does not condense returns to the burner and heats the retort itself.

phases.name: Refining
phases.text: The last volatiles are driven off and fixed carbon rises. The result is a more stable charcoal of consistent quality.

control.label: Control and traceability
control.title: Every kiln, measured every 30 seconds.
control.lede: Piroliswiss Control is our own kiln-monitoring system. It records the temperature of every retort through the whole cycle, warns when something goes out of range and keeps the curve of every load.

points.title: Four probes per kiln
points.text: Front, centre, back and gas outlet. The spread between probes shows whether the load carbonises evenly.

points.title: Cycle phases
points.text: Loading, heating and pyrolysis are detected from temperature, with the start time and duration of each phase.

points.title: Real-time alarms
points.text: Immediate warning when a kiln passes its threshold, a probe fails or a node stops sending data. Without a connection, readings are queued and sent later.

points.title: Per-lot record
points.text: Every cycle is stored and can be exported, so each lot can be traced back to its temperature curve.

control.note: Piroliswiss Control is an in-house system in development. The screen shows the application design with sample data.

model.label: Operating model
model.title: From biomass to final product, in five steps.
model.lede: Every project starts with a legal document, not a chainsaw. We only work on land with an approved change-of-use plan, under a contract with the owner.

steps.title: Biomass collection and sorting
steps.text: We collect wood and forest residue from the authorised area and sort it before processing.

steps.alt: Log saw and conveyor at the camp
steps.title: Wood processing
steps.text: Logs are cut and prepared on site for loading into the retorts.

steps.title: By-product separation and processing
steps.text: Pyroligneous acid is condensed; charcoal fines go to briquetting.

steps.title: Packaging, logistics and export
steps.text: Bagged on site and shipped to industrial and international buyers.
